selection: Among candidates meeting the regret bound, maximize retrieval/answer latency savings vs always-hybrid minus measured routing overhead; then macro-F1; then rule, knn, logistic, llm; then lower tau. If none meet the bound, do not freeze.
oracle: Minimum measured latency among non-error correct routes; errors never correct. Exact ties graph, vector, hybrid.
fallback: Escalate an empty/invalid graph result or empty/low-score vector result to hybrid; log the executed route. Offline latency charges the failed initial retrieval plus hybrid, conservatively.
interpretation: Internal tuning only. Genuine system errors retain cost and score zero. Infrastructure failures cannot provide timing labels. One route sample does not guarantee deterministic generation.
amendment_reason: User accepted Phase 1C and selected no-templates with fresh clean route measurements. Preserve Phase 2 measured-latency selection; do not reuse the ordinal Phase 1C labels.
error_policy: User-approved 2026-10-13: retain genuine model/query errors as incorrect and include measured execution cost. Retry only infrastructure failures; unknown failures stop for classification. Exclude cache hits and infrastructure-retry-contaminated timings.
